result:
The 4-second lower third is in `s3/index.html`, and `npx hyperframes check --json` reports `ok: true` with no errors.

- **Motion:** "Mohammed" slides in from the left, then "Maintainer, Girth" follows 0.2 s later. Both sit beside an accent bar. After that the whole block drifts 24 px right until the end, so it isn't a static hold (that would draw a static warning).
- **Text variables:** The name and title are exposed as `name` and `title` composition variables.
- **Frame 0 warning:** The check still warns that frame 0 shows mostly the background, which a slide-in does by design. I started the bar partly drawn so something is on screen at 0 s. I left the warning otherwise.
- **Nested-element warning:** It also warns that `#lower` contains a nested `#bar`. I left it because `s2` uses the same single-clip structure.
- **Info notices:** There are two info notices about text extending outside its box and the canvas. They come from the off-screen starting position of the slide-in.

I also recorded this one with `girth made`.
